**Finding: MFN — compliant (preferred position), no redline proposed.**

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation of any kind, and certainly none running against Bluefly:

- **§ 4.1 Charges** (p0052) sets Charges purely by reference to Service Option Attachments and Order Forms — no benchmarking, best-pricing, or best-terms undertaking by Customer.
- **§ 13.3 Amendments** (p0164) is an ordinary mutual written-amendment clause with no price-adjustment or matching mechanic.
- **§ 14.16 Freedom of Action** (p0200): "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." — affirmatively inconsistent with any duty on us to extend IBM terms offered to third parties.

Targeted searches for MFN, "no less favorable", best price/discount, comparable customers, right-to-match, and notify-and-offer mechanics returned no hits anywhere, including the definitions and preamble. Accordingly the preferred element ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor") is already met on the document's own words.

One note for the deal team rather than the redline: there is likewise no IBM-granted MFN in our favour. That is a commercial ask we could pursue on pricing if desired, but its absence is not a playbook deviation and does not warrant a markup here.
